mapper.select: SELECT v.id, v.title_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.change_type, v.change_summary, v.company_name, v.taxpayer_id, v.registered_address, v.phone, v.bank_name, v.bank_account, v.subject_ids_json, COALESCE(NULLIF(publisher.display_name, ''), v.created_by) AS created_by, v.created_at FROM invoice_title_version v LEFT JOIN finance_user publisher ON LOWER(publisher.username) = LOWER(v.created_by) AND publisher.deleted = 0 WHERE v.id = #{id}

SELECT v.id, v.title_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.change_type, v.change_summary, v.company_name, v.taxpayer_id, v.registered_address, v.phone, v.bank_name, v.bank_account, v.subject_ids_json, COALESCE(NULLIF(publisher.display_name, ''), v.created_by) AS created_by, v.created_at FROM invoice_title_version v LEFT JOIN finance_user publisher ON LOWER(publisher.username) = LOWER(v.created_by) AND publisher.deleted = 0 WHERE v.title_id = #{titleId} AND v.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY v.version_no DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(version_no), 0) + 1 FROM invoice_title_version WHERE title_id = #{titleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoice_title_version (title_id, version_no, status, change_type, change_summary, company_name, taxpayer_id, registered_address, phone, bank_name, bank_account, subject_ids_json, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{titleId}, #{versionNo}, #{status}, COALESCE(#{changeType}, 'EDIT'), #{changeSummary}, #{companyName}, #{taxpayerId}, #{registeredAddress}, #{phone}, #{bankName}, #{bankAccount}, #{subjectIdsJson}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invoice_title_version WHERE title_id = #{titleId}

SELECT v.id, v.title_id, v.version_no, v.status, v.change_type, v.change_summary, v.company_name, v.taxpayer_id, v.registered_address, v.phone, v.bank_name, v.bank_account, v.subject_ids_json, COALESCE(NULLIF(publisher.display_name, ''), v.created_by) AS created_by, v.created_at FROM invoice_title_version v LEFT JOIN finance_user publisher ON LOWER(publisher.username) = LOWER(v.created_by) AND publisher.deleted = 0 WHERE v.title_id = #{titleId} ORDER BY v.version_no DESC, v.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
